sessions.description: Full-bag gapping session - driver through lob wedge, mapping carries
sessions.diagnosis: Near-neutral swing path but face hangs open on long clubs (driver face 9.2 deg open vs path 0.6 deg). Right miss grows from 4i up. Short clubs show mild pull/draw bias. Iron contact solid; fat/thin lapses on partial wedges.
sessions.drills: Lead-hand grip check: 2-2.5 knuckles;9-to-3 toe-up drill with 8i then 4H at 70%
sessions.notes: Best of bag: 7i-9i smash 1.26-1.39 with clean gapping. Driver was the weakest club (163m avg, 66m spread). 4I/4H/3W all cover ~170-173m; 5I and 6I only 4m apart - a set-composition question worth revisiting.
sessions.data_notes: No impact-point or attack-angle fields in this xlsx export - carry/speed/spin only.

sessions.description: 7-iron block, first trial of the stronger 2.5-knuckle grip
sessions.diagnosis: Grip-change transition dip, not a failed grip. After switching to 2.5 knuckles: faces 7-10 deg open, closure rate ~1850 deg/s vs 2400+ on good swings, dynamic loft up to 32-36 deg, club speed down ~5 km/h. Steering instead of releasing; speed converted to height and spin rather than distance.
sessions.drills: Half swings at 60-70% before any full swing;Sim targets face 0-3 deg open and side spin under 500 rpm;One ball per 45-60s with fresh regrip
sessions.notes: 16 shots in ~6 minutes - rapid-fire fatigue visible late in the session. Counter-evidence the new grip works: shot 2 face 0.4 deg closed, smash 1.35, 139.9m; shots 11 and 14 near-straight on the new grip. Expect 2+ weeks before power returns. Dynamic lie averaged ~7 deg toe-down - flagged for fitting review.

sessions.description: Iron block - 9I, 8I and 7I, first session after the grip change bedded in
sessions.diagnosis: Major improvement. Face angle average fell from +5.83 deg (25 Aug 7I) to +1.36 deg on the 45-shot 9I block, with 16 shots actually closed - the release is returning. Absolute side spin roughly halved (1226 -> 727 rpm). Face-to-path now frequently negative. Remaining issue is consistency not direction: strike quality still scattered (smash 0.51-1.35) with several duffs and short mishits.
sessions.drills: Continue 9-to-3 toe-up at 60-70%;Step 2 of progression: keep 9-to-3 length, raise speed to 80-90%;Only lengthen to full swing once face holds at speed
sessions.notes: Shots 51-53 (7I) read smash 1.40/1.45/1.36 with dynamic loft 23.8-25.4 deg, back spin 3773-3949 - likely a strong-lofted 7-iron rather than a measurement error; worth confirming the stamped loft.
sessions.data_notes: CLUB LABELS CORRECTED at Steven's instruction: shots 1-4 logged as 7I were actually 8I; shots 6-50 logged as 8I were actually 9I; shots 51-53 were genuine 7I. Shot 5 does not exist. Sensor-garbage rows disregarded: shot 20 (smash 0.63, side spin -11935), 26 (smash 0.51, backspin -5509), 23 and 45 (carry 0.0).

sessions.description: SGT Tour Championship Round 1 back nine at Trosper
sessions.type: SGT competitive round - back nine, 52 captures
sessions.diagnosis: NEW dominant fault: topping long clubs. Attack angle strongly POSITIVE on 3 wood (+4.5 to +10.7 deg) - hitting up on the ball from the turf - producing contact 14-30mm LOW on the face and carry of literally zero on at least four shots (3W totals 79.8, 110.3, 106.7; 8I total 131.5). Impact width also consistently heel-side (-5.9 to -27.6mm). Face control was worse than 26 Aug but is NOT the main cause of the score; one 8 iron at 11.8 deg open.
sessions.drills: Ball position check - likely too far forward for a fairway wood off the deck;Low-point drill: strike a coin/tee just ahead of the ball;Return to 9-to-3 at 80-90% before full swings
sessions.notes: Score +8 to +27 over the nine (+19). Good swings still present: 3W carries of 187.9m (smash 1.46, face 0.1), 192m (1.42), 183.4m (1.39), 155.8m (1.40) - the club works when the low point is right. Every club averaged low-face contact except the 5-iron. Rough penalty measured: shots that struck well still played 25-38m shorter once GSPro applied its lie penalty.
sessions.data_notes: DATA tab averages for the round: 4H carry 57.6m / impact height -10.8mm; 8I carry 114.1m / -12.4mm; SW carry 64.6m / -7.3mm; 5I carry 85.9m / +23.9mm. Shot-by-shot rows were transcribed from 36 of 52 GSPro+ProTee captures; club assignment inferred by shifting the GSPro club box back one shot. Round record originally used inconsistent field names (holes/gross vs shot_by_shot/strokes_back_nine, score vs strokes) - normalized in build.py.

sessions.description: Club fitting data as requested by the golf-club-fitting skill
sessions.focus: Fitting: lie angle, closure rate, face control
sessions.diagnosis: LIE ANSWERED from the DATA tab. Dynamic lie is TOE DOWN on every club and VARIES BY CLUB: 8I -9.5 deg (n=20), 6I -7.8 (n=14), 7I -7.1 (n=20). Because it differs between clubs it is NOT a flat calibration offset - it is a real delivery/equipment trait. Toe-down delivery points shots right, and off-line confirms it: 7I +19.6m R, 6I +15.9m R, 8I +4.8m R. Closure rate 2041-2332 deg/s, still around the threshold where the face hangs open. Smash healthy at 1.30-1.32 across all three.
sessions.drills: None set - this was a data-gathering session
sessions.notes: Gapping is tight: 6I 134.9m / 7I 126.3m / 8I 115.8m - only 8.6m between 6I and 7I, worth a look at set composition. Two smoked shots (166.8m 6I, 139.1m 8I) both had face-to-path near zero and lie within 0.1 deg of the session average - confirms the toe-down lie is present even on the best strikes, so it's a fitting item, not a swing symptom.
sessions.data_notes: Rebuilt from a single zoomed-out DATA tab screenshot: 54 rows, all 26 columns, correct club counts (6I 14 / 7I 20 / 8I 20), lie on every shot, no duplicates - this capture method replaces individual per-shot screenshots going forward. Transcription check vs the sim's own Average row: lie, spin loft and closure reproduce exactly; club speed off by 0.7-0.8 km/h on 7I/8I blocks, face/apex/descent by <0.3 - use the sim's own per-club averages as authoritative, not means of the per-shot rows. Sim averages: 6I carry 134.9 cs 128.8 lie -7.8 face 3.8 AoA -0.1 spinloft 26.9 apex 20.9 descent 39.0; 7I carry 126.3 cs 123.6 lie -7.1 face 4.2 AoA -1.9 spinloft 29.9 apex 17.9 descent 36.3; 8I carry 115.8 cs 119.6 lie -9.5 face 2.5 AoA -1.3 spinloft 30.4 apex 17.1 descent 36.5.

rounds.strategy: Driver benched. 3W off all tees, 4H from fairway, 3W on par 5s.
rounds.notes: First competitive 9 on SGT. Short game carried the round: holed 18ft (h5), 13ft (h6) and two 6-footers (h7, h9), lagged 38ft and 26ft to tap-in range. Wedges into greens were sharp: 35yd to 6ft, 42yd to 9ft, 26yd to 8ft. Nearly every long shot found rough. Blow-ups on holes 1 and 8 were compounded long-club misses, matching the open-face pattern from sim data.

rounds.strategy: Driver benched - 3 wood off every tee (GSPro 'Driver' selection is a 3 wood).

hole_progress.note: Tee shot topped (carry 0, total 79.8m). Recovered with a 187.9m 3 wood, wedge to 6.6m, bogey.
6 iron tee shot thin - 85.9m carry on a 153m hole, struck 23.9mm high on the face. Bogey.
Two topped 3 woods (carry 0, totals 110.3m and 106.7m). Triple.
8 iron topped - carry 0, impact 30.4mm low on the face, face 11.8 deg open. Quadruple.

rounds.notes: Steven's own summary: 'hindenburg'. Not one fairway hit off the tee on the par 4s and 5s - only 3 shots all nine were played from a fairway, against 20 from rough. Topped 3 woods off the tee (57, 59, 64 yds) guaranteed a scramble before the second shot. Hole 17: tee shot into deep rough, then 25 yds backwards to a tee box, seven on a par 3. Short game held up: 19 putts, holed from 6 and 7 ft.
